column1: # Altin Peak: the mine has collapsed with men pinned behind the rubble.

column3:
The supports gave way.
Men are trapped behind
the fallen rock.{page_break}The water is rising.
Will you help us?{end_now}
Thank you. Quickly!\nThey won't last long\nin that water.{end_wait}
Then find someone who\nwill help. I won't\nleave them here.{end_wait}
The roof could fall\nagain. We must brace\nit before we dig.{end_wait}
I'll find some beams.\nIsaac, help me brace\nthe roof.{end_wait}
Watch for loose rock.\nI'll keep an eye\non the ceiling.{end_wait}
Brace the roof.\nThen clear the rocks.\nTogether.{end_wait}
I heard them calling\nthrough the rocks.{page_break}You got them out.\nHere. Take this.{end_wait}
They're all outside.\nWe can go home.\nThe mine can wait.{end_wait}
